KALAIGNAR MAGALIR URIMAI THOGAI SCHEME (KMUT) 
 
1. 
Gist of the Scheme 
Under the flagship Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thogai Scheme, the Government of Tamil Nadu provides financial assistance of Rs. 1,000 per month directly to women heads of eligible households across Tamil Nadu via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) into their bank accounts. 
 
2. 
Objective 
To recognize the uncompensated labor of women, enhance their financial independence, improve their livelihood standard, and reduce family poverty. 
 
3. 
Eligibility Criteria 
- The applicant must be a female head of the family as recorded in the Smart Family Card (Ration Card).
- Minimum age of applicant: 21 years.
- Family annual income must be less than Rs. 2.5 Lakhs.
- Family electricity consumption should be below 3600 units per year.
- Family landholding should be less than 5 acres of wetland or less than 10 acres of dry land.
 
4. 
Ineligibility / Exclusions 
- Families with members who are income tax payees or government employees / pensioners.
- Families owning a four-wheeler (car, jeep, tractor, etc.) for personal use.
- Elected public representatives (MLAs, MPs, Municipal Chairpersons, Panchayat Presidents).
 
5. 
Benefits Provided 
Rs. 1,000/- per month transferred directly to the eligible woman's Aadhaar-linked bank account (DBT) on the 15th of every month. 
 
6. 
Documents Required 
- Smart Family Card (Ration Card)
- Aadhaar Card of the female head of household
- Aadhaar-linked Bank Account Passbook details
- Electricity Consumer Account Number / Bill details
 
7. 
How to Apply & Department 
- Applications are received at designated special camps conducted at local fair price shops (PDS outlets) and e-Sevai centers across Tamil Nadu.
- Department: Special Programme Implementation Department & Revenue and Disaster Management Department, Government of Tamil Nadu.
